tools.description: Replace old_string with new_string in a file. old_string must match exactly and be unique unless replace_all is true. The file must be read with Read first.

tools.name: Bash
tools.description: Run a shell command in the repository directory and return its combined output. timeout is in milliseconds: default 120000, maximum 600000.

tools.name: Glob
tools.description: Find files matching a glob pattern (supports **). Returns paths sorted by modification time, newest first.

tools.name: Grep
tools.description: Search file contents with a regular expression. output_mode: files_with_matches (default), content, or count.
